capability_statement: Operators can see recorded agent-session tool calls as governance decisions and risk classes without opening raw session streams.
before_state: Mission Control listed tool calls but did not summarize whether they were allowed, denied, review-required, risky, external-write, or dangerous.
after_state: Mission Control exposes tool_governance_replay with decision counts, risk counts, replay items, evidence refs, and not-proven boundaries.
scenario: Before signing off a runtime-backed answer, the operator checks Mission Control to see whether the underlying tool calls were governed and whether any call needs review.
five_minute_demo: Run visibility-export and inspect tool_governance_replay in .aof/artifacts/visibility/current/mission-control.json.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Removes first-pass manual inspection of raw agent-session JSON for tool governance status.
cognitive_load_removed: Operators no longer need to infer approval and safety state from individual session events.

capability_matrix.before: Tool calls were visible only as session events.
capability_matrix.after: Tool calls are classified by governance decision and risk class.
capability_matrix.user_value: A runtime-backed answer can be reviewed for tool governance from Mission Control first.

not_proven: Self-hosting product value evidence does not prove broad adoption, semantic truth, provider behavior, or unrecorded tool-call absence.
